data.rationale: Scenario-owned durable data observed in the canonical data directory.

budget.rationale: The durable SQLite database includes component-test evidence and currently measures about 299MiB; a 512MiB ceiling bounds the measured multi-stage payload workload while preserving rollup counters.

gate_evidence.rationale: Gate ledgers, stamp reports, and baseline captures are durable recorded verdicts; 1212269 bytes were measured on 2026-08-27.

budget.rationale: The durable gate cohort measured 1212269 bytes on 2026-08-27; 256 MiB allows long-lived verdict history without authorizing deletion.

retention.rationale: Retention receipts are durable records of cleanup decisions and enforcement outcomes.

budget.rationale: Retention receipts are bounded JSON records and must remain durable for auditability.

storage.rationale: Storage surfaces include component data and durable gate evidence in the scenario state class.

service.name: react-component-library
service.description: Central UI for designing, previewing, editing, and tracking shared React UI components across Vrooli scenarios.

agent-manager.description: Optional server-side dispatcher for attributable assisted extraction and adoption workflows; direct RCL APIs remain available when it is unavailable.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Assisted extraction and adoption workflows remain unavailable and are stored as unavailable; direct catalog and adoption APIs remain available.

experience-manager.description: Provides the shared experience-spec contract and capture reconciliation used by RCL experience evidence.
experience-manager.degraded_behavior: Catalog, component contracts, and direct library APIs remain available; experience capture and reconciliation are unavailable until experience-manager is healthy.

ui-health.description: Provides the shared UI inventory and provenance contracts used by RCL inventory adapters.
ui-health.degraded_behavior: Catalog and component APIs remain available; cross-scenario UI inventory integration is unavailable until ui-health is healthy.

typescript-code-graph.description: Supplies the parsed TypeScript import graph required by the blocking graph-reconciled catalog gate.
